added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no head gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

assertion_audit.fails_if: the test's unused KAPPA constant falls below 1.6; changing the map's elongation behavior leaves it green
the free solver refuses or stalls on this synthetic map
the solved free height differs from the test's Z_FREE constant; changing the same constant in free_map and the expectation survives
the free solve returns either commanded target within 1e-3
the synthetic augmented solve stalls, accepts residual above 1e-12 or fails to put state[1] at the supplied target; a wrong booked-support centroid survives
both target runs return the same compensating state element
the one pinned compiled executable stalls, has high residual or returns state[1] off either supplied target; separate pinned and unpinned executables remain undetected

findings.text: blocking: pinned_fixed_point has no production caller or route from ForwardSolveRequest, and VerticalPin contains no declared coil set or uniform radial-field basis, so an elongated forward solve cannot use the landed pin.
blocking: KAPPA is checked only against 1.6 and never enters free_map or pinned_map, so the tests do not exercise an elongation-dependent analytic carrier.

blocking: height is state[1] from the test's own centroid_height and is compared with the target passed to _pin; a regression from the booked-support current centroid to an unrelated state coordinate stays green.
blocking: compiling pinned_fixed_point once for two targets cannot show the same compiled program serves the unpinned solve, whose state has two elements instead of the pinned solve's three.
blocking: the required 550-cell lobe cold solve and both residual histories were not run, so whether the pin clears the measured 1.54987e-3 stall is unknown.
blocking: the rendered right panel is a synthetic vertical-residual contour independent of R, not a pinned terminal flux contour through nova.media with axis, nulls and wall as brief.txt:13 requires.

blocking: baseline_suite ends EXIT=124 without a summary and after_suite is empty although after-suite.log names the earlier a9b737eef revision, so no failure delta can be derived for reviewed head 296ecbd37.

follow-on: VerticalPin duplicates ConstraintBinding and ConstraintPair in nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:179-280, while pin_residual duplicates CurrentCentroidConstraint.residual at :969-980; the new definitions extend neither owner.
follow-on: the rendered left legend overlaps the unpinned trace near the free root, so the delivered figure needs a clear legend placement.

follow-on: expected Z_FREE is also the constant free_map uses to define its root, so changing that root constant leaves this assertion green and does not independently protect the claimed free height.

item_verdicts.diff: commits a9b737eef7fec9d41d23907d6cf170b65b014a51 and 296ecbd37d339fbb9c3b5fc92daaa850a84815cc add a generic pin wrapper, a synthetic three-test carrier and documents and figure; the second commit changes only the test seed and newline.
item_verdicts.done_when: brief.txt:9-15 requires a physical source, one compiled program for pinned and unpinned runs, an elongated carrier, the 550-cell comparison, a terminal flux figure and complete paired suites; tests/equilibrium/test_solve_vertical_pin.py:102 checks only two pinned targets and manifest.md:18-19 leaves the suites unreadable.
item_verdicts.goal: brief.txt:1 requires a vertical pin on every elongated production forward solve before fitting; nova/equilibrium/solve.py:232 adds a generic helper with no production caller.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md:10-34 records three focused passes and two negative-control failures, while expressly leaving production wiring and the 550-cell run open and carrying no completed after_suite.
item_verdicts.write_paths: manifest.md:3 grants solve.py, the equilibrium test, the prototype directory and the research, figure and evidence paths; the six paths in git diff 8e0ccc13..296ecbd37 are all inside those grants.

justifications.durability: tests/equilibrium/test_solve_vertical_pin.py:85-88 reddens when field leverage is removed, but :20 and :49 make elongation and physical centroid independent of the asserted result.
justifications.evidence: manifest.md:18-19 lacks completed suite arms, docs/research/vertical-pin.html:108 says the 550-cell run is unmeasured, and tests/equilibrium/test_solve_vertical_pin.py:102 proves only pinned targets.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/solve.py:203 follows the generic solver's map idiom, but :52 introduces a separate pin binding beside the constraint owner and :245 claims a basis field that VerticalPin lacks.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/solve.py:232 adds a helper but nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2602 and solve_request.py:555 never call it or carry a declared compensating source.
justifications.reuse: nova/equilibrium/solve.py:52 duplicates the target, scale and initial-unknown binding owned by nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:179-280, and its pin row at :219 duplicates CurrentCentroidConstraint.residual at constraint.py:969-980 rather than extending that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the six paths changed between 8e0ccc13 and 296ecbd37 all fit the scopes in manifest.md:3 and carry work implied by brief.txt:9-17.
